reviewer: Independent B2 journal schema and access reviewer

B2.1.procedure: Run the journal PostgreSQL integration test against a disposable PostgreSQL 16 database.
B2.1.observed: Concurrent replay returned one stable attributed moment. Blank text was rejected, a finalized asset stayed unchanged, and optimistic recovery kept prior wording.

B2.2.procedure: Drive the real notebook editor through the Chromium browser suite.
B2.2.observed: Keyboard capture, double-tap, 422 draft retention, separate tab and learner selections, and account-switch clearing passed.

B2.3.procedure: Run learner and guardian flows through the production HTTP routes in Chromium.
B2.3.observed: A guardian posted and recovered a signed suggestion. Only the learner could change their own words or confirm current scribed words. A stale scribed confirmation was rejected.

T2.procedure: Run npm --prefix web test against the built Rust server, built Svelte client and disposable PostgreSQL 16.
T2.observed: The learner saved one sentence independently, a double submission made one entry, a guardian posted a suggestion, and the learner recovered earlier attributable wording. Validation kept the typed text.

journal-retry.procedure: Run python3 tools/run_cases.py --case journal-retry -- node web/tests/journal.mjs --case against the real local app.
journal-retry.observed: The authorized concurrent HTTP submissions created one moment with the same ID on both responses and reload, voice student and zero added assets.
